meta.title: SportArena - Court booking & sports matchmaking
meta.description: Conflict-free court booking, VietQR deposits and real-time matchmaking for sports sessions.

home.badge: Court booking & matchmaking in real time
home.heroText: Pick any time slot without worrying about double bookings. Pay the deposit with a VietQR code, invite more players to your match and get notified the moment someone asks to join.
home.featuresSubtitle: From choosing a court to inviting your friends to play.

calendar.title: Bookings never overlap
calendar.desc: A time slot is locked as soon as someone holds it, and released automatically after 15 minutes if no deposit is paid.

qr.title: Fast deposits with VietQR
qr.desc: Every booking gets its own QR code. Once you transfer, the status updates instantly with no page reload.

match.title: Find players, split the cost
match.desc: Open a match while booking, set the skill level and split the cost or cover it all. The host approves each player.

1.title: Choose a court
1.desc: Filter by sport and area, and see prices by time slot.

2.title: Pick a time
2.desc: Tap the free slots on the calendar and the price and deposit are calculated for you.

3.title: Scan the deposit QR
3.desc: You have 15 minutes to transfer, with a countdown right on screen.

4.title: Invite friends
4.desc: Open a match, approve players and chat live.

home.footer: © 2026 SportArena - Real-time court booking & sports matchmaking platform.

policy.title: Hold Policy
policy.manual: The court is held for 60 minutes, extended when you report your transfer so the owner can check it. If it is not confirmed in time, the booking is cancelled automatically and the court is released.
policy.auto: The court is held for 15 minutes. If the deposit is not completed in that time, the booking is cancelled automatically and the court is released for other players.
